# Test data

`test_map.sg` is an original demonstration scenario created specifically for OpenDis2. It is included as a reproducible integration-test fixture and as a small demonstration of the engine prototype.

The scenario structure and content were authored for this repository. The file does not contain the original game's graphics, sounds, fonts, executable code, or archive contents. Running it still requires a legally obtained local installation of Disciples II: Rise of the Elves because OpenDis2 loads the required game resources from the user's installation.

Unless stated otherwise, this authored fixture is distributed under the same GPL-3.0-only license as the rest of the repository.
